new_packages.label_en: The Divine Union, Holy Eating, and the Feast
new_packages.reason: Torah #62 opens and closes with the same concept: eating that produces the yichud of the Holy One and Shekhinah. Section aleph states: 'עַל יְדֵי אֲכִילָתָם שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל נַעֲשֶׂה יִחוּד קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּהּ אַפִּין בְּאַפִּין, בִּבְחִינַת: גֹּשִׁי הֲלֹם — דָּא יִחוּד ק"ב ושכינתה.' Three bechinas are embedded here: (1) 'גֹּשִׁי הֲלֹם' = יחוד ק"ב ושכינה; (2) 'וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלָיו יְהוּדָה — דָּא תִּקְרֻבְתָּא מַלְכָּא בְּמַלְכָּא' = yichud (from the Zohar); (3) at the end, line 48: 'וַיַּסֵּב — לְשׁוֹן סְעֻדָּה, הַיְנוּ לְשׁוֹן הֲסִבָּה' — the word vayasev IS the language of feasting/leaning at table. This forms a cluster of concepts that are all different expressions of the same HOLY EATING / DIVINE UNIFICATION reality: אכילה = יחוד; ויגש = תקרובתא; גשי הלם = יחוד; ויסב = לשון הסיבה (holy feasting). The current dataset has an eitza edge (id=1302) for this — אכילה → יחוד — but correctly classifies it as cause-effect. However, the additional pairs (גשי הלם = יחוד, ויגש יהודה = תקרובתא מלכא) are explicit bechina equivalences ('דָּא יִחוּד', 'דָּא תִּקְרֻבְתָּא') that should be bechina edges. This domain forms an independent good package: the HOLY EATING / YICHUD cluster.

new_packages.independence_justification: This cluster has an independent structural role: it is the GOAL and FRAME concept of the entire Torah — the yichud of God and Shekhinah achieved through holy eating. It is structurally distinct from Package 1 (which contains the MEANS: faith and fasting) and Package 2 (which contains the OBSTACLE: desires/klipot). The yichud/eating cluster represents the OUTCOME DOMAIN — the sacred encounter that holy eating enables. With 5-6 distinct nodes (גשי הלם, ויגש יהודה, תקרובתא, ויסב, אכילת ישראל, יחוד itself) all with explicit bechina language ('דָּא', 'הַיְנוּ'), this is a genuine independent bechina package.

new_packages.label: מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבִּקְדֻשָּׁה, הֲלָכוֹת, וְשָׁלוֹם
new_packages.label_en: Holy Dispute, Halachic Rulings, and Peace
new_packages.reason: Sections ב and the appendices (שייך לאות ב) of Torah #62 develop a rich bechina domain about the inner structure of intellectual/spiritual conflict and its resolution through halachic law. The Rebbe states (lines 10-13): (1) 'מַחֲלֹקֶת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שָׁרְשׁוֹ מִן הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבִּקְדֻשָּׁה' — the evil-division has its root in the holy dispute (cause-effect, eitza — already in dataset as eitza); (2) 'מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבִּקְדֻשָּׁה, הוּא מַחֲלֹקֶת תַּנָּאִים וַאֲמוֹרָאִים שֶׁבַּגְּמָרָא' — the holy dispute IS the dispute of the Tannaim and Amoraim (bechina equivalence); (3) 'תִּקּוּן הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבִּקְדֻשָּׁה, הֵן הֲלָכוֹת פְּסוּקוֹת. כִּי פְּסַק הֲלָכָה הוּא הַשָּׁלוֹם' — the tikkun of the holy dispute IS the ruling halachot; a ruling IS peace (halachic ruling = שלום). Line 13: 'זֶה אוֹתִיּוֹת שָׁלוֹם, נוֹטְרִיקוֹן: וְדַע מַה שֶּׁתָּשִׁיב לְאֶפִּיקוֹרוֹס' — the word שלום IS the acronym for 'know what to answer the heretic.' And line 9: 'הַסְתָּרַת הַיְדִיעָה, הֵן הֵן אֶפִּיקוֹרְסוּת וְקֻשְׁיוֹת' — concealment of knowledge IS heresy. These form a 6+ node bechina cluster: מחלקת שבקדשה = מחלקת תנאים ואמוראים; הלכות פסוקות = תיקון המחלקת; פסק הלכה = שלום; שלום = ראשי תיבות ודע מה שתשיב; הסתרת הידיעה = אפיקורסות וקושיות. This cluster is the intellectual/Torah-law dimension of the teaching — an independent domain with 5+ concepts and explicit bechina language, distinct from the faith/fasting domain (Package 1) and the desire/klipot domain (Package 2).

new_packages.independence_justification: The מחלקת/הלכות/שלום cluster is structurally independent from the two proposed packages and from NP-62-1. Its domain is: THE INTELLECTUAL-LEGAL ARCHITECTURE of how inner conflict (evil) originates in holy Talmudic dispute, and how learning halachic rulings resolves BOTH the holy dispute AND its evil descendant. This is a distinct conceptual domain (Torah scholarship, legal peace, intellectual battle) separate from: Package 1 (faith and fasting = physical/spiritual practice), Package 2 (desires = klipot = body-level opposition), and NP-62-1 (yichud = the ultimate goal). The cluster has 6-7 nodes with explicit bechina language ('הוּא', 'הֵן הֵן', 'הוּא הַשָּׁלוֹם') and occupies a distinct structural role in the Torah's argument. Note: the evil mirror of this package is the מחלקת היצר הרע cluster (the evil dispute is the distorted descendent of the holy one), which would form a corresponding evil package with concepts such as מחלקת היצר הרע, אפיקורסות, לב חלוק.

observations:
Torah #62 contains 15 total edges (3 bechina, 12 eitza) in the current dataset — a very sparse representation of a conceptually dense Torah. The source text has at least 20 bechina-language formulations, of which only 3 are currently captured. Two clear independent domains are missing from the bechina edge set:

1. The YICHUD/EATING domain (NP-62-1): The Torah opens and closes with the theme of holy eating creating the yichud of God and Shekhinah. Four distinct bechina pairs (גשי הלם = יחוד; ויגש יהודה = תקרובתא; תקרובתא = יחוד; ויסב = סעודה) are explicitly stated with Zoharic 'דָּא' language. This is the most central cluster of the Torah and is entirely absent from the bechina dataset.

2. The HALACHIC PEACE domain (NP-62-2): The Torah's longest sustained argument (sections ב and the appendices) develops the concept that inner intellectual division (= origin of heresy) is healed by learning halachic rulings (= peace). The bechina chain (holy dispute = Talmudic dispute; ruling = peace; peace = acronym for answering heretics; concealment of knowledge = heresy) forms a 6-7 node cluster with no bechina edges in the dataset.

The Torah's good/evil mirror structure in Torah #62:
- Good: יחוד ק"ב ושכינה (NP-62-1) ↔ Evil: קלפות/תאוות (Package 2) — the yichud vs. the husks
- Good: אמונה/תענית (Package 1) ↔ Evil: מחלקת היצר הרע / אפיקורסות (NP-62-2 mirror)
- Good: שלום/הלכות (NP-62-2) ↔ Evil: לב חלוק / הסתרת הידיעה (evil side of NP-62-2)

The Torah's argument in five stages:
  Stage 1 — Holy eating requires purified food, and purification requires faith [opening theme]
  Stage 2 — Faith requires intellectual clarity (answerable questions) OR pure emunah (unanswerable ones); the yetzer hara hides the paths of intellect [NP-62-2 domain]
  Stage 3 — To heal the inner division: study halachic decisors, which connects to holy peace and silences heresy [NP-62-2]
  Stage 4 — To complete faith (draw distant ones near): purify speech by fasting, which starves the klipot/desires [Package 1 + Package 2]
  Stage 5 — When faith is complete and eating is pure, the yichud of God and Shekhinah is achieved [NP-62-1]
